name: Ingest Example Legacy Model Description
purpose: Execute the first MVP ingestion workflow by transforming a raw example legacy model description into a human-readable ingestion report.
task_goal: Register a raw input artifact, create a structured ingestion report, prepare placeholder feedback and traceability artifacts, and stop before approved input promotion.

input_artifacts.description: Simple raw legacy engineering description used as the first MVP ingestion example.
input_artifacts.expected_relevance: Used to test extraction of source information, interpreted engineering information, candidate downstream elements, assumptions, gaps and review questions.
input_artifacts.usage_rule: This artifact may only be used to generate an ingestion report. It shall not be used directly for approved input, approved model data or SysML v2 generation.

agent_personalities.role_in_task: Optional later review of completeness, traceability and review readiness.

expected_output_artifacts.description: Human-readable ingestion report created from the raw example input.
Structured placeholder for future human feedback on the ingestion report.
Traceability placeholder linking the task, recipe, input artifact, context files and generated ingestion report.

execution_rules: Load the selected systems engineer agent personality.
Separate extracted source information from interpreted engineering information.
Create review questions for the human reviewer.
Create placeholder feedback and traceability artifacts if supported by the MVP implementation.
forbidden_actions: Do not approve the raw input.
Do not promote content into data/approved_input/.
Do not create approved model data.
Do not generate SysML v2 output.
Do not modify files in model/architecture/.
Do not treat Apollo 11 as raw legacy input.
Do not load complete external repositories into the prompt by default.

review_gate.name: Ingestion Review Gate
review_gate.rule: The generated ingestion report must be reviewed by a human before any content can be promoted into approved input.

initial_mvp_success_criteria: The raw input artifact is registered.
The ingestion report is generated in data/ingestion_reports/.
The ingestion report has status ready_for_review.
The report separates source information, interpretation, assumptions, gaps and review questions.
No approved input is created automatically.
No SysML v2 output is generated.
Traceability to task, recipe, input artifact and context files is prepared.
notes: This is the first executable MVP task.
The input file may be replaced later with a real legacy engineering artifact.
For the first run, the system may create placeholder feedback and traceability files.
The task intentionally stops before human approval.
